news.titleEn: U.S.-China trade truce extended for two months, Bessent says, as Xi begins state visit
news.conclusionEn: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the US-China tariff truce, due to expire November 10, has been extended to January 10, 2027, just as Xi Jinping's state visit and summit with Trump got underway.
news.conclusionZh: 美中关税休战延长至2027年1月10日，恰逢习近平访美峰会启幕
news.whyEn: Extending the truce removes an imminent tariff-escalation risk for global markets and gives both sides more time to negotiate a broader deal, directly affecting supply chains, tariffs and investor sentiment worldwide.
news.whyZh: 推迟关税升级风险，为更大贸易协议争取时间，影响全球供应链与市场情绪
news.detailEn: Bessent said the extension, which he called the 'Busan Agreement,' came after an unscheduled meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in Washington, ahead of the formal Trump-Xi summit on September 24. He said the extra two months could allow a larger economic package to be finalized by January. The move came alongside continued negotiations over rare-earth export controls, which remain a separate and unresolved sticking point. Markets had been watching closely for signs of renewed tariff conflict given the truce's looming November deadline.
news.detailZh: 贝森特表示，这项被他称为「釜山协议」的延期，是在与中国国务院副总理何立峰在华盛顿举行的一次临时会晤后达成的，此时距9月24日特朗普与习近平的正式峰会仅一步之遥。他称多出的两个月时间或能让双方在明年1月前敲定一份更大规模的经济协议。与此同时，围绕稀土出口管制的谈判仍在继续，这仍是尚未解决的独立症结。此前，随着11月休战截止期临近，市场一直密切关注关税冲突是否会重燃。

news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield rockets to 19-year high as oil, inflation fears mount
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year US Treasury yield surged to about 5.1% on September 23, its highest since 2007, as surging oil prices and strong economic data fueled inflation worries.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10年期国债收益率飙至5.1%，创2007年以来新高
news.whyEn: Higher long-term yields raise borrowing costs for mortgages, corporate debt and governments worldwide, and signal markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated for longer.
news.whyZh: 长期利率上升推高房贷与企业融资成本，反映市场预期美联储将维持高利率更久
news.detailEn: The yield spike followed a weak $70 billion five-year Treasury note auction, stronger-than-expected US business activity data, and hawkish comments from a senior Federal Reserve official. Rising Brent crude prices, which climbed above $103 a barrel amid Middle East tensions, added to inflation concerns. The 20-year and 30-year yields also pushed above 5% for the first time since 2023. The 30-year mortgage rate rose to 7.26%, its highest in nearly two years, squeezing US homebuyers just as the Fed weighs further rate moves.
news.detailZh: 此次收益率飙升，源于一场认购疲软的700亿美元五年期美债拍卖、强于预期的美国商业活动数据，以及美联储一位高级官员的鹰派表态。受中东局势紧张影响，布伦特原油价格升破每桶103美元，进一步加剧了通胀担忧。20年期和30年期国债收益率也自2023年以来首次升破5%。30年期抵押贷款利率升至7.26%，为近两年最高水平，在美联储权衡是否进一步加息之际，给美国购房者带来更大压力。

news.titleEn: Current price of oil as of September 23, 2026
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude jumped 3.8% to $103.08 a barrel on September 23, snapping a five-day losing streak as renewed US-Iran tensions revived fears of a Middle East supply disruption.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油单日上涨3.8%至103.08美元，中断五日跌势
news.whyEn: Oil at multi-decade-relative highs feeds directly into inflation, central bank policy and consumer costs worldwide, and remains highly sensitive to any shift in the Iran conflict.
news.whyZh: 高油价直接推高全球通胀与消费成本，且对伊朗局势变化高度敏感
news.detailEn: The rebound came as fears grew that a fragile de-escalation in the seven-month Iran war could unravel, threatening tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Prices remain nearly 49% above year-ago levels because of the ongoing conflict and prior attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline. Saudi Arabia is reportedly preparing to restart pipeline exports that bypass the Strait, which could ease supply risk in coming days. Analysts say prices could swing sharply in either direction depending on how the parallel Iran ceasefire talks at the UN progress.
news.detailZh: 此轮反弹的背景是市场担忧持续七个月的伊朗战争脆弱的缓和局面可能再度破裂，威胁经霍尔木兹海峡的油轮运输。由于冲突持续及此前沙特东西输油管道遭袭，油价目前仍比去年同期高出近49%。据报道，沙特阿拉伯正准备重启绕开霍尔木兹海峡的管道出口，未来几天或能缓解供应风险。分析师表示，随着联大期间伊朗停火谈判的进展，油价可能出现大幅波动。

news.titleEn: Iran presents US with road map for regionwide ceasefire and Hormuz reopening
news.conclusionEn: Iranian officials handed the US a proposed road map at UN-sidelines talks in New York on September 23, offering a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days and phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗在联大边会向美方提出地区停火及分阶段重开霍尔木兹海峡方案
news.whyEn: A credible path to ending the seven-month Iran war would be one of the biggest de-escalation events of the year, directly affecting oil markets, Gulf shipping and global security risk.
news.whyZh: 若伊朗战争走向实质缓和，将是年内最大规模的地缘降温事件，直接影响油价与海湾航运
news.detailEn: The talks, mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt, produced a detailed Iranian proposal described as an agenda for future substantive negotiations rather than a final deal. Iran is seeking an end to the US naval blockade and the release of frozen Iranian assets as part of any de-escalation. Trump has ruled out lifting the blockade until Iran shows sufficient goodwill, keeping the outcome uncertain. Both sides described the meeting as constructive, with another round of talks expected soon.
news.detailZh: 此次由卡塔尔、巴基斯坦和埃及斡旋的会谈，产生了一份详细的伊朗方案，被形容为未来实质性谈判的议程草案，而非最终协议。伊朗方面寻求解除美国海军封锁，并释放被冻结的伊朗资产，作为局势缓和的一部分条件。特朗普则表示，在伊朗展现足够诚意之前不会解除封锁，使结果仍存变数。双方均称此次会谈具有建设性，预计短期内还将举行新一轮谈判。

news.titleEn: Paramount reaches settlement with states, clearing path for $110 billion Warner Bros. Discovery merger
news.conclusionEn: Paramount Skydance reached a settlement with a 12-state antitrust coalition on September 21-22, removing a key legal obstacle to its roughly $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.
news.conclusionZh: 派拉蒙与12州达成和解，扫清收购华纳兄弟探索1100亿美元的法律障碍
news.whyEn: The deal would combine two major film studios, two streaming platforms (Paramount+ and HBO Max) and two news networks (CBS News and CNN), reshaping the global media and entertainment industry.
news.whyZh: 合并将整合两大电影公司、两大流媒体平台及两家新闻机构，重塑全球媒体格局
news.detailEn: The settlement resolves a legal challenge from a coalition of state attorneys general who had raised antitrust concerns about the combined company's market power. Shareholders approved the merger back in April, and the transaction is expected to close around Q3 2026; if it hasn't closed by September 30, WBD shareholders are entitled to a quarterly 'ticking fee.' The combined entity would blend Paramount and Warner Bros. film studios, Paramount+ and HBO Max streaming services, and CBS News and CNN. Analysts expect the deal to yield roughly $6 billion in cost synergies once integration is complete.
news.detailZh: 此次和解化解了一批州检察长此前对合并后公司市场支配力提出的反垄断质疑。该并购已于今年4月获股东批准，交易预计于2026年第三季度左右完成；若未能在9月30日前完成，华纳兄弟探索股东将有权获得按季计算的「计时费」补偿。合并后的公司将整合派拉蒙与华纳兄弟两大电影厂牌、Paramount+与HBO Max两大流媒体平台，以及CBS新闻和CNN两家新闻机构。分析师预计，整合完成后每年可实现约60亿美元的成本协同效应。

news.titleEn: Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for 'energy ceasefire,' calls for trilateral meeting with Putin, Trump
news.conclusionEn: President Zelenskyy told the UN General Assembly on September 23 that Ukraine is ready for an energy-infrastructure ceasefire and urged Trump to arrange a trilateral meeting with Putin, hours after Russian drones killed two people in Kyiv.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基在联大呼吁能源设施停火并促成与普京三方会谈，同日基辅遭无人机袭击致2死
news.whyEn: A potential energy-infrastructure truce could ease Europe's winter energy security risks and signal a shift toward de-escalation in a war that has run since Russia's invasion, though continued strikes show the conflict remains active.
news.whyZh: 能源设施停火或缓解欧洲冬季能源安全风险，但持续空袭显示冲突仍在延续
news.detailEn: Russia struck Kyiv with drones in a daylight attack hours before Zelenskyy's UN address, killing two people and wounding 23, part of what he said was evidence Russia is preparing a new mass attack on Ukraine. In his speech, Zelenskyy called Putin 'patient zero' for spreading war and instability, and urged the world to keep squeezing Russia's oil-and-gas revenues. He said Ukraine would accept a ceasefire on strikes against energy and civilian infrastructure if Russia reciprocates, and separately, France and the US said they would pursue such a moratorium. Trump and Zelenskyy held talks on the sidelines of the summit, though no trilateral meeting with Putin has yet been scheduled.
news.detailZh: 在泽连斯基联大演讲前几小时，俄罗斯出动无人机对基辅发动白昼袭击，造成2人死亡、23人受伤，他称这是俄罗斯正在准备对乌克兰发动新一轮大规模袭击的迹象。演讲中，泽连斯基称普京为散布战争与动荡的「零号病人」，并呼吁国际社会继续压缩俄罗斯的石油天然气收入。他表示，若俄方对等回应，乌克兰愿意就停止打击能源和民用设施达成停火；法国与美国也分别表示将推动这一停火协议。特朗普与泽连斯基在峰会期间举行了会谈，但与普京的三方会晤尚未确定日期。

news.titleEn: Everything new coming to Meta's AI agent Muse
news.conclusionEn: Meta's Muse personal AI agent, launched in September and expanded to macOS on September 19, has become the top free app on the iPhone App Store with more than 2.5 million downloads.
news.conclusionZh: Meta个人AI助手Muse登顶iPhone免费榜，下载量已超250万
news.whyEn: Muse's rapid adoption shows strong consumer demand for AI agents that can act on a user's behalf across email, calendar, payments and shopping, intensifying competition among Big Tech's AI assistants.
news.whyZh: Muse的快速走红显示消费者对可代为执行任务的AI助手需求强劲，加剧科技巨头AI竞赛
news.detailEn: Muse connects to categories including email, calendar, payments, health, shopping and smart home, and can carry out multi-step tasks with minimal supervision, sold on $20 and $100 monthly tiers with a free weekly token allowance. Meta released a macOS version on September 19, letting the agent complete tasks directly on a user's computer for the first time. The rapid uptake comes as rivals including OpenAI and Google race to ship their own agentic AI products. Meta has kept the rollout US-only and restricted to adults amid ongoing scrutiny of AI agents' access to sensitive personal data.
news.detailZh: Muse可接入邮件、日历、支付、健康、购物及智能家居等多个类别，能在较少人工干预下完成多步骤任务，提供每月20美元和100美元两档订阅，并附带每周免费额度。Meta已于9月19日推出macOS版本，首次让该助手能直接在用户电脑上完成任务。在OpenAI、谷歌等竞争对手争相推出各自的智能体AI产品之际，Muse的快速走红格外引人注目。出于对AI助手接触敏感个人数据的持续审视，Meta目前仅在美国上线，且限成年用户使用。

news.titleEn: Led by China and US borrowing, the world now owes a record US$365 trillion debt: IIF
news.conclusionEn: Global debt rose more than $10 trillion in the first half of 2026 to a record above $365 trillion, led by borrowing in China and the US, according to the Institute of International Finance.
news.conclusionZh: 国际金融协会：今年上半年全球债务激增逾10万亿美元，创365万亿美元新高
news.whyEn: Record debt combined with rising interest rates raises the risk of fiscal strain for governments and corporations worldwide, and could constrain future spending and growth.
news.whyZh: 高债务叠加利率上升，加大全球政府与企业财政压力，或制约未来增长空间
news.detailEn: Emerging-market debt drove much of the increase, rising $6.5 trillion to exceed $110 trillion, with China accounting for the largest share of that growth. Governments and non-financial corporations recorded the biggest increases, while advanced-economy borrowing growth slowed sharply compared with 2025. Global debt now stands at about 310% of GDP, still well below its 2021 peak, but average G7 government borrowing costs have hit their highest level since mid-2008. The IIF said high interest rates, energy prices and the Iran conflict are all constraining new borrowing even as debt-servicing costs climb.
news.detailZh: 新兴市场债务是此轮增长的主要推手，上半年增加6.5万亿美元，突破110万亿美元，其中中国贡献了最大增幅。政府部门和非金融企业的债务增幅最为显著，而发达经济体的举债增速较2025年明显放缓。目前全球债务规模约为GDP的310%，仍明显低于2021年的峰值，但七国集团政府平均借贷成本已升至2008年年中以来最高水平。国际金融协会表示，高利率、高能源价格及伊朗冲突都在抑制新增借贷，即便偿债成本持续攀升。

businessTips.explanationEn: A network effect occurs when a product or service becomes more valuable to each user as more people use it. This creates a powerful moat because a large, established network is hard for competitors to replicate — new entrants must convince users to switch to a product that starts out less useful simply because fewer people are on it. Businesses that achieve strong network effects often see growth compound rapidly once they reach critical mass.
businessTips.explanationZh: 网络效应是指一款产品或服务的价值会随着使用人数增加而对每个用户变得更高。这会形成强大的护城河，因为一个庞大成熟的网络很难被竞争对手复制——新进入者必须说服用户转向一个起步时因用户少而价值更低的产品。一旦达到临界规模，具备强网络效应的企业往往能实现快速的复合增长。
businessTips.exampleEn: A messaging app is nearly useless if none of your friends use it, but becomes essential once most of your contacts are on it — making it very hard for a new competing app to gain traction even with better features. Marketplaces like eBay show the same dynamic: more buyers attract more sellers, and more sellers attract more buyers, reinforcing the platform's dominance over time.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一款即时通讯软件如果没有朋友在用，几乎毫无价值；但一旦大多数联系人都在用，它就变得不可或缺——这使得新的竞争对手即便功能更好，也很难获得用户。像eBay这样的交易平台也呈现同样的动态：买家越多吸引越多卖家，卖家越多又吸引更多买家，从而不断强化平台的主导地位。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building and growing a business using only personal savings and revenue the company generates itself, without raising outside investment. It forces founders to reach profitability quickly and keep costs lean, since there's no investor cash cushion to fall back on. The trade-off is slower growth compared to a well-funded competitor, but founders retain full ownership and control, and never have to answer to investors about strategy.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自我筹资（Bootstrapping）是指仅依靠个人积蓄和公司自身产生的收入来构建和发展业务，而不引入外部融资。由于没有投资人的资金缓冲，这迫使创始人必须尽快实现盈利并严格控制成本。其代价是相比获得充足融资的竞争对手，成长速度可能较慢，但创始人能保留完整的所有权和控制权，无需就战略方向向投资人交代。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance designer launches a side-hustle selling website templates, reinvesting each month's profit into better marketing and new templates instead of taking out a loan or seeking investors. Companies like Mailchimp famously bootstrapped for over a decade before becoming a multi-billion-dollar business, proving that outside funding isn't always necessary to scale.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由设计师开启副业，销售网站模板，把每月利润重新投入更好的营销和新模板开发，而不是申请贷款或寻找投资人。像Mailchimp这样的公司就曾自我筹资长达十多年，之后才成长为市值数十亿美元的企业，证明外部融资并非规模化发展的必要条件。

businessTips.explanationEn: The yield curve plots interest rates on government bonds of different maturities, from short-term to long-term. Normally, longer-term bonds pay higher yields to compensate investors for locking up money longer, producing an upward-sloping curve. When short-term yields rise above long-term yields — an 'inverted' curve — it often signals investors expect economic slowdown or rate cuts ahead, and has historically preceded many recessions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收益率曲线描绘的是不同期限（从短期到长期）政府债券的利率水平。通常情况下，期限越长的债券收益率越高，以补偿投资者资金被长期占用的机会成本，因此曲线呈向上倾斜状态。当短期收益率高于长期收益率时——即「倒挂」——往往意味着投资者预期经济将放缓或未来会降息，历史上这种倒挂常常是经济衰退的前兆。
businessTips.exampleEn: In late September 2026, long-term Treasury yields surged to multi-decade highs alongside rising oil prices and inflation fears, steepening the yield curve as investors demanded more compensation for holding long-dated bonds. Investors watch shifts like this closely because a steepening curve can signal expectations of stronger growth or persistent inflation, while a flattening or inverted curve often points to caution ahead.
businessTips.exampleZh: 2026年9月下旬，受油价上涨和通胀担忧影响，美国长期国债收益率飙升至数十年高位，收益率曲线随之变陡，因为投资者要求持有长期债券获得更多补偿。投资者密切关注这类变化，因为曲线变陡可能预示经济增长强劲或通胀持续，而曲线变平或倒挂则往往意味着需要保持警惕。
